title: How many companies were inspected by the FDA in cities located in Rowan County in August?
text:
How many companies were inspected by the FDA in cities located in Rowan County in August?
There were two companies in cities associated with Rowan County, North Carolina, that received two FDA inspections in August, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
The companies inspected operate in the Food and Cosmetics sector.
There was one company in line with FDA regulations who don’t need to adjust their management operations or regulatory/administrative actions. One should take voluntary action to correct the organization's management operations.
The FDA routinely inspects facilities across the nation to determine if the workplace and their products are compliant with FDA-regulated laws and regulations implemented to improve overall public health. Inspection results are then disclosed publicly.
According to its website, the FDA is a government agency that is primarily responsible for monitoring the production and distribution of human and animal drugs, biological products, medical supplies and tobacco products for safety and quality.
| Company Name | Area of Business | Inspection Date | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Carolina Beverage Corporation | Food and Cosmetics | 08/10/2026 | No Action Indicated (NAI) |
| Daily Manufacturing, Inc. | Food and Cosmetics | 08/19/2026 | Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) |
